# Shop settings (fictional)

| Key | Description | Topic | Scope |
| :- | :- | :- | :- |
| [`shopTheme`](#shoptheme) | Colours of the storefront | Display | Any file |
| [`shopLock`](#shoplock) | Freeze the catalogue | Catalogue | Managed |
| [`shopHome`](#shophome) | Start page of the storefront | Display | User |
| [`shopCurrency`](#shopcurrency) | Default currency | Payments | User or managed |
| [`shopDrafts`](#shopdrafts) | Keep unsent orders | Orders | User, local, or managed |
| [`shopTips`](#shoptips) | Show tips at start | Display | Global config |

You can write `shopTheme` as `storeTheme` on recent versions; you can write `shopLock` as `storeLock` too.
